answer: In our Proof of Agent network, every node anchors identity into cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To access the trusted haven of decentralized compute, each newly registered identity must stake bonding collateral that doubles with each replica, inflicting exponential capital exhaustion on any adversarial swarm. Genuine nodes whisper peer validations across the consensus mesa, while superlinear costs make scaling fake agents economically ruinous.
